maya: Quick async — sprint finale check. Please reply with 3 bullets: what you did / blocker / today. I'll be offline from 5pm PT but monitoring canary. @raj please prioritize infra quota if needed.

Blocker: Dedicated GPU quota still pending from cloud — I filed ticket with infra (INC-4421).

Blocker: need a jenkins secret for the long-run test — @leah can you share?
Today: will post PR for #412 (model-serving) for review.

leah: shared secret in #eng-infra DM. Also hotfixed staging env var that was causing deploy failure earlier:
```bash
export REDWOOD_FEATURE_FLAGS="enable-canary,no-metrics"
```
Staging now green.

emma: Quick QA note — found 1 regression in structured output when model returns empty tool outputs. Filed ticket: RD-867.
I'll add a focused prompt test to the eval suite.

zach: @maya ping — PR #412 ready, small doc update included. Please review when you have a sec.

maya: Reviewing PRs now. If we see quota still blocked at 12:30PT, we'll switch canary to smaller batch size and increase prefix cache.
Link to runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/specs-finalization
